title: HERES HOW TO CANCEL YOUR SUBSCRIPTION
body: FIVE STARS ONLY SO MY REVIEW IS VISIBLE: IN TRUTH THIS APP IS NEGATIVE STARS. If you are like me and many other people writing reviews here, you may have paid for the .99/week trial. By now I’m sure you have also realized that the stories on this app are lazy and repetitive and want to cancel that subscription immediately. Here’s how: On the home page of the app there is a button at the bottom right that says “mine”, click that and then click “1v1 Service” (it looks like a customer service line with a smiley face with headphones). From there you should be able to cancel your subscription with no further issues. Keep in mind that I used Apple Pay when purchasing, so unless you did also- there isn’t a guarantee it works the same way. I hope this helps some people out.
